scope: Only reconstructions from the completed selector_eos_20261101 campaign; archived victim references remain valid frozen inputs. No comparison with earlier reconstruction predictions is included.

interpretation_limits: Controls are partial ablations preserving some response-dependent information.

Pilot decoder and transformation seeds are the exact BLAKE2s seeds frozen in the 31-October input inventory; no new trace realizations are sampled. This still does not recover undocumented seeds of the earlier historical pilot.
MAP has only first-segment reconstruction with a full-response reference; transformed inputs have unequal encoder coverage.
Prompt and seed repeats are crossed, not independent new prompts; calibration/test are exact-prompt-disjoint but share scenarios.
Padding costs are payload-only; the exact 31-October random-padding realizations are retained and their costs differ from expected costs.
No transformation contrast identifies information-theoretic secrecy or semantic disclosure.

matched_reference_rendering_contrast.scope: Matched full-response contrast of verified versus legacy rendering under the corrected selector. Both length inputs and scoring references change; the components are not separately identified.

candidate_audit.floating_sum_check: Independent double-precision fsum compared with saved CUDA float32 sums at max(1e-5,2e-6*max(1,sum(abs(scores)))) tolerance; saved scalars then reproduce exact stable sorting and duplicate handling.

pad_32.interpretation: Constant actual reconstructor inputs cannot carry response-specific length variation; nonzero lexical overlap also reflects the reconstructor prior. Equal cross-model predictions use matched prompt and seed pairs.

main_covariate_regression.estimand: Descriptive OLS including two malformed-reference diagnostic series; no causal attribution
main_covariate_regression.source_features: Intercept plus model indicators (first label omitted); reference Unicode characters/100, mean logged token bytes, token count>=512
